package application

import (
 "context"
 "io"
 "net"
 "net/http"
 "strings"
 "sync/atomic"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/ws"
 "github.com/gorilla/websocket"
)

type socketInput struct { Email string `json:"email" validate:"required,email"` }
type socketController struct {calls atomic.Int32}
func (c *socketController) Message(ctx context.Context,input socketInput) error {
 c.calls.Add(1)
 return ws.Send(ctx,ws.TextMessage,[]byte(input.Email))
}

func TestGeneratedWebSocketAssembly(t *testing.T) {
 const validates={{VALIDATOR}}
 app,options,err:=BuildApplication();if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 controller:=&socketController{}
 app.Constructor(func()*socketController{return controller})
 if err:=app.WebSocket().Register("/ws/validation",(*socketController).Message);err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 listener,err:=net.Listen("tcp","127.0.0.1:0");if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 address:=listener.Addr().String();listener.Close()
 options.Address=address;options.EnableGracefulShutdown=true;options.ShutdownTimeout=3*time.Second
 ctx,cancel:=context.WithCancel(context.Background());defer cancel()
 done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){done<-app.RunContext(ctx,options)}()
 stopped:=false
 defer func(){if !stopped{cancel();select{case err:=<-done:if err!=nil{t.Error(err)};case <-time.After(5*time.Second):t.Error("WS application did not stop")}}}()
 transport:=http.DefaultTransport.(*http.Transport).Clone()
 defer transport.CloseIdleConnections()
 client:=&http.Client{Timeout:time.Second,Transport:transport}
 deadline:=time.Now().Add(10*time.Second)
 for {
  response,err:=client.Get("http://"+address+"/health")
  if err==nil {io.Copy(io.Discard,response.Body);response.Body.Close();if response.StatusCode==200{break}}
  if time.Now().After(deadline){t.Fatal("HTTP listener was not ready")}
  time.Sleep(20*time.Millisecond)
 }
 transport.CloseIdleConnections()
 dial:=func()*websocket.Conn{
  c,_,err:=websocket.DefaultDialer.Dial("ws://"+address+"/ws/validation",nil);if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  _=c.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(5*time.Second));return c
 }
 connection:=dial();defer connection.Close()
 if err:=connection.WriteJSON(socketInput{Email:"kim@example.com"});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 _,message,err:=connection.ReadMessage();if err!=nil || string(message)!="kim@example.com"{t.Fatalf("normal message: %q %v",message,err)}
 if err:=connection.WriteJSON(socketInput{});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
 _,message,err=connection.ReadMessage()
 expectedCalls:=int32(2)
 if validates {
  if !websocket.IsCloseError(err,websocket.ClosePolicyViolation){t.Fatalf("validation close: %v",err)}
  expectedCalls=1
  connection.Close();connection=dial();defer connection.Close()
  // Confirm server-side activation before asserting shutdown of this connection.
  if err:=connection.WriteJSON(socketInput{Email:"kim@example.com"});err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)}
  _,message,err=connection.ReadMessage();if err!=nil || string(message)!="kim@example.com"{t.Fatalf("reconnected message: %q %v",message,err)}
  expectedCalls++
 } else if err!=nil || len(message)!=0 {t.Fatalf("omitted validator changed behavior: %q %v",message,err)}
 if controller.calls.Load()!=expectedCalls{t.Fatalf("handler calls: %d",controller.calls.Load())}
 cancel()
 select{case err:=<-done:stopped=true;if err!=nil{t.Fatal(err)};case <-time.After(5*time.Second):t.Fatal("shutdown timed out")}
 _,_,err=connection.ReadMessage()
 if !websocket.IsCloseError(err,websocket.CloseNormalClosure){t.Fatalf("normal shutdown close: %v",err)}
 rebound,err:=net.Listen("tcp",address);if err!=nil{t.Fatal("listener still owned:",err)};rebound.Close()
 if strings.Contains(address,"0.0.0.0"){t.Fatal("fixture must bind localhost")}
}
